note: Replace every row below. These are shape examples, not a starter set: a registry of questions nobody asked measures nothing.
howToBuildThis: Take a real search term you already rank for, or a gap keyword from data/intake.json.
Search that TERM on Reddit (scripts/questions-for.mjs does this for you) and read how people actually phrase it.
Paste their phrasing in as the query. Do not reword it into your vocabulary.
Record sourceType honestly: exact is the asker's own words, naturalized is your rewording, synthesized is your framing over evidenced pain. Prefer exact.
Keep the core fixed once it is set. A question that changes wording between runs cannot be trended.
evidenceGrade is confidence that people ask it, NOT how commercially valuable it is. That is what priority is for, which is why grade C plus P0 is a valid row.

cohorts.generic: The category question, your brand name absent. This is the cohort that measures whether you exist to an answer engine.
cohorts.brand-defence: Your brand named in the question. Measures whether the engine describes you correctly, and it will almost always mention you by construction. Never averaged with generic.
